question: On 23 September 2026, Israel’s Central Elections Committee illegally and undemocratically made the decision to bar the Joint List and the United Arab List, Ra’am, from running in the country’s parliamentary elections. It also decided to prevent Balad leader Sami Abu Shehadeh and Ofer Cassif, a Hadash party MP and leader of the Communist Party of Israel, from standing.

These unacceptable decisions, which will be examined by Israel’s Supreme Court, have a serious impact on citizens’ political representation. They are part of the growing repression of voices in Israel that condemn the policy of genocide against the Palestinian people, the occupation and colonisation of the Gaza Strip, the West Bank and East Jerusalem, and Israel’s breaches of international law.
Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement establishes respect for human rights and democratic principles as an essential element of the agreement. In view of the above: 1.
Will the Council condemn these undemocratic decisions and call for them to be reversed?

In view of these undemocratic decisions, which come on top of Israel’s serious and repeated violations of international law, will it suspend the EU-Israel Association Agreement with immediate effect and impose an arms embargo on Israel?
